summary: The filing reports Innovative Industrial Properties, Inc. (IIP) entering loan agreements — not a special situation. On May 19, 2026, two IIP subsidiaries (Borrowers) separately signed secured term loans totaling $21.96M with Amalgamated Bank at a fixed 6.67% interest rate, 25-year amortization, maturing June 5, 2031, secured by first-priority liens on respective properties. IIP provided an unsecured guaranty. This is routine debt financing without acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring elements.
